reason: I forget the bottle on the counter half the time and I travel a lot, so a counted sachet I can toss in my bag is the first thing that actually fits my life. At $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee, I'll try one box.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer, so after the launch price I'm not sure I'd keep paying it.
would_change_my_mind: If the price were $29.99 with no launch discount, I would skip it.
